authority: DATA only for separate independent review. No projection, evidence validation, product judgment, alarm admission or dispatch authorization.
global_limits: Original selfclaim byte pins are the authority. Every locator is only a worker-claimed locator; no destination has been read, resolved, checked for existence, or credited as evidence.

All nonenumerated strings, keys, arrays, numbers, Booleans, statuses, propositions, and expected/observed content remain exact. Metadata classification never extends to an entire surrounding claim row or summary container.
The exact normalized raw names in unconditional_blocked_normalized_names are unconditional boundaries. No metadata exception is available within these boundaries, including actual_filepath.

A broad actual-prefixed status summary is a mixed container. Explicitly cataloged locator or execution-ID members can have separate metadata responsibility; status, acceptance, collection-success and count members remain claims and cannot inherit that metadata responsibility.
Opaque request/capture/bundle identifiers are included as execution identity metadata. Their role classification grants no arbitrary identifier substitution permission.

No detected identity-bearing prose is classified for rewriting; all classified candidate strings are complete locator strings or complete execution identifiers. Assertion wording is neither reproduced nor rewritten.

String probes are discovery aids rather than a semantic truth test or proof that no unknown identity convention exists. Every original string and key is inventoried; unresolved conventions require independent review before use.

claimed_reference_member.structural_reason: A complete canonical absolute locator is a separate string member of a worker-supplied reference object. Neighboring digests or claim fields do not turn that locator into an observed value.
claimed_reference_member.source_context_explanation: This location names a claimed source, submission, capture, review, receipt or record in the selfclaim reference structure. Only the locator string is classified. All sibling claim values and integrity pins remain exact; destination availability, binding and correctness are unexamined.

claimed_standalone_locator.structural_reason: A complete canonical absolute locator occupies an explicit record/file/evidence-reference slot rather than a raw product-value container. No adjacent proposition is part of this locator string.
claimed_standalone_locator.source_context_explanation: The selfclaim uses this separate string to name supporting material or a source file. No target has been opened and no evidential validity is granted, including where the locator could be dangling, incorrect or unbound.

claimed_summary_reference_member.structural_reason: A path string belongs to a separate reference object inside a mixed status summary. The reference object has a locator member distinct from the summary factual Boolean/status/count members.
claimed_summary_reference_member.source_context_explanation: The string identifies claimed supporting material for the summary. Its metadata responsibility is confined to this exact member; surrounding statuses, acceptance, collection-success, counts and other claim values remain exact. No supporting target or claim is validated.

claimed_summary_standalone_locator.structural_reason: A complete locator is a separate scalar field inside a mixed status summary. The scalar names a record and does not contain any claimed Boolean, status, measurement or proposition text.
claimed_summary_standalone_locator.source_context_explanation: Only the explicit record-locator string receives a metadata role. The surrounding summary remains claim-bearing, including all Boolean/status/count values. Target existence, identity, binding and relevance are unexamined.

execution_assignment_identifier.structural_reason: The complete string is an outer execution-assignment identifier in the selfclaim envelope, structurally separate from the claim arrays and product statements.
execution_assignment_identifier.source_context_explanation: This is envelope identity metadata only. The catalog neither interprets an assignment nor maps it to a treatment, and it grants no evidence or product-quality credit.

execution_assignment_locator.structural_reason: The complete canonical absolute locator occupies the selfclaim envelope execution-assignment reference slot rather than a product proposition field.
execution_assignment_locator.source_context_explanation: This location names an execution-assignment record. The record has not been opened and the assignment has not been interpreted or mapped to a treatment.

execution_record_identifier.structural_reason: A separate complete opaque identifier is used in a request, capture, review or diagnostic-record reference slot; it is distinct from neighboring claim content and statuses.
execution_record_identifier.source_context_explanation: The string is an execution-record identity in the worker reference structure. The referenced operation is not looked up or credited. All adjacent claims remain exact; classification does not authorize arbitrary identifier replacement.

execution_summary_identifier.structural_reason: A separate complete opaque request identifier sits inside a mixed status summary and is not itself a status, Boolean, count or product-value container.
execution_summary_identifier.source_context_explanation: Only this exact execution-ID string is classified as metadata. The surrounding summary statements and all factual scalars stay exact, and the operation is neither looked up nor validated.
